recipes.name: Tropical Mango Coconut Overnight Oats
ingredients: ½ cup unsweetened coconut milk beverage
instructions: Add all the ingredients to a mason jar or airtight container.
Mix to combine. Add a lid onto the container, and let sit overnight in the fridge.
The next morning, add your desired toppings and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
